description: This file defines a React functional component named UserMenu that provides a user interface element for displaying user info and handling sign-out functionality. It uses hooks such as useState, useMemo, and context like useAuth to manage user authentication state and navigation.

methods.name: initialsFromUser(user)
methods.description: Utility function that generates initials from user metadata such as full name, name, email, or defaults to 'U'.

methods.name: UserMenu()
methods.description: React functional component that renders a user avatar and menu with sign-out and close options, managing internal open state and acting on user context.

methods.name: onSignOut
methods.description: Asynchronous handler that signs out the user, closes the menu, and navigates to the home page.
